Trump bragging about the US being the "#1 producer of oil & natural gas in the world" feels like a good time to remind everyone: 

We have 12 years left to deal with the #climatecrisis. Our obsession w/ fossil fuels has to end. 

It's time for a #GreenNewDeal. 

#SOTU

Another year, another summit! 

Beyond excited to lead public & youth mobilization for the @UN Secretary-General’s 2019 #ClimateActionSummit. 

This is the year countries must step up ambition to tackle the #climatecrisis. People everywhere are demanding it.

Let’s deliver 🙌🏼
